credits.title: 23 Seconds
credits.overview: A former Silat champion enters amateur MMA to honor his brother lost in a Phuket Tsunami, while underground Muay Thai fighter Somchai is chosen to represent Thailand at the world championship in Jakarta. Two warriors, who will prevail?

credits.title: Badut Gendong
credits.overview: After losing his wife and unborn child to gang violence, a grieving clown returns to his village with her body, only to become entangled in a conflict with a ruthless developer and a sinister ritual that unleashes dark forces.

credits.title: The Unholy
credits.overview: A former clergyman finds himself back in his old boarding school where the disturbances experienced by its community might help him regain his faith and tie up loose ends in regards to his son's death by a deadly spirit.

credits.title: Legend of Gatotkaca
credits.overview: A young man discovers he is the descendant of a powerful warrior and must unlock his hidden abilities to fight an ancient enemy who seeks to alter history and destroy the world.
